title: A sign test does not detect a common 372.5-day timing phase in 1104 selected Kepler systems
abstract: We test the public Holczer transit-time catalog for a shared component at the Kepler orbital period. We select one sequence per host by coverage and flags, which gives 175,162 records in 1,104 systems. A fixed-period harmonic fit and conditional host sign test give p = 0.312. Early and late data give p = 0.593 and 0.629. Both marginal median coefficient intervals contain zero. A common 0.1-minute added sinusoid gives p below 0.04 at four tested phases. This is a response check, not a detection-efficiency estimate. The test does not exclude effects with different signs or phases across detector channels. We correct a timing-unit label error in the public mirror by comparison with the original table. We report no new planet or physical cause and no independent telescope confirmation. The package includes code, a checked subset, exact raw provenance, all fit outputs, a figure, and offline instructions.
